_about: Ground truth for samples/flutter_vulnerable_app, in the format of samples/ground_truth.json. Each tag marks one line: [Dxx] Dart code, [Mxx] Android, iOS, Firebase, web and build configuration, [Gxx] dependencies. 'cwe' lists the weaknesses really present on that line as canonical ids (sca.cwe.canonical; empty = the line is safe on purpose), 'also' lists extra findings that are acceptable there, 'hard' marks cases that no planned rule or check finds; each note starts with the rule or check expected to report the line. Most tags are a comment on the line ([D01]). A tag with an 'anchor' labels a line that cannot hold a comment (an XML attribute inside a start tag, an Info.plist key, key.properties, .env): its line is the first line of anchor.file (relative to the app folder) that contains anchor.text, searching from the first line that contains anchor.near (from line 1 when there is no near). samples/flutter_safe_app has no vulnerabilities: every finding there is a false positive.
